name: orderverify
description: OrderVerify: hold risky M-Pesa orders before dispatch, paid per check via x402 on Stellar.

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @orderverify/web" "npm run dev -w @orderverify/verify-api"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p packages/fixtures --noEmit && tsc -p services/verify-api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
